jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer Entry Screening in Boerne, TX to monitor entry points, verify access, and patrol assigned areas. You will deliver outstanding customer service and ensure a secure, welcoming environment at a community location.

Daytime shifts with overnight hours are available; pay rate is $17.00 per hour. A background check and drug screening are required; a Guard Card/license is preferred, with CPR/First Aid and badge experience valued.

jobs.description:

Previous dispatch experience and strong customer service skills are essential.
